Same initial state, four ways — how the paradigms diverge (120 steps)

Top row: CPM, vertex, center-based each simulated alone. Bottom row: the same three inside the tri-coupled consensus. Each column is one paradigm, standalone vs coupled.

536 real cells from a MIBI-TOF human colon-carcinoma field of view (squidpy mibitof), 120 coupled steps (every 5th frame shown). The standalone paradigms reorganize the tissue differently (differential-adhesion sorting) while the coupled set stays mutually registered.
